jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 

Looking for freedom and your own dedicated truck (after your onboarding period)? This is your route:

    
• 
        
What: National transport (tipper and curtain-sider) of steel and miscellaneous materials.

    
    
• 
        
When: Early mornings (start between 4 AM and 6 AM) for a full 10-12 hour day.

    
    
• 
        
How: Independently, punctually, and in close contact with dispatch.

    

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid CE license + Code 95.

    
    
• 
        
Speaks Dutch, French, or English.

    
    
• 
        
An early bird who loves working independently and accurately.

    
    
• 
        
An honest team player who cares for the equipment and the customer.

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Harelbeke site, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician in night shift As a maintenance technician, you are passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these findings accurately, allowing us to act proactively and minimise unplanned downtime. 
 
• You perform scheduled maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
 
• You work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
 
• You provide external employees with the necessary support and follow-up to make their contribution effective and efficient. You also supervise technical trainees and new employees to help them grow in their roles. 
 
• You keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo). 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in night shift

Lead the technical evolution of a modern cloud platform, combining .NET development, software architecture, AI-assisted engineering, and technical leadership.

Our partner is a technology-driven organization investing heavily in cloud-native development, AI-assisted software engineering, and modern platform architecture.

As part of a growing engineering team, they are looking for a Senior Developer / Tech Lead who can combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities.

This role goes far beyond pure development. You'll influence architectural decisions, mentor developers, drive engineering excellence, and help shape the future of an AI-native software delivery environment where AI agents actively support coding, testing, and refactoring activities.
Senior Tech Lead | The Role
• Design, build, and enhance scalable applications using .NET, C# and Microsoft Azure.
• Transform business requirements into robust technical solutions, architectures, and implementation plans.
• Establish and promote high engineering standards through code reviews, mentoring, and technical coaching.
• Work alongside AI-powered development tools to accelerate delivery while ensuring the quality, security, and maintainability of the resulting software.
• Drive architectural decisions and contribute to the evolution of cloud-native and event-driven systems.
• Identify opportunities to improve development practices, platform performance, delivery processes, and technical solutions.
Senior Tech Lead | The Profile
• You bring extensive experience in .NET / C# software development, ideally within complex enterprise environments.
• You have strong expertise with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based architectures.
• You are comfortable working with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• You have experience with Angular or modern front-end development frameworks.
• You regularly leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions and understand both their strengths and limitations.
• You have a proven ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, challenge architectural decisions, and drive software quality across a development team.
• Complete proficiency in Dutch, English and French
 

Nice to Have

• Experience with Event-Driven Architecture, messaging systems, and asynchronous integrations.
• Exposure to GraphQL, PostgreSQL, or document-oriented data management.
• Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and scalable software design practices.
• Experience with event sourcing patterns and distributed applications.
• Familiarity with modern search and analytics technologies.
• Microsoft Azure or DevOps certifications are considered a plus.

jobs.occupation: Sales Executive Benelux - Watches Industry (Dutch Native)
jobs.description:
Our client is a distinguished leader in the fine watch and luxury industry, renowned for craftsmanship and timeless excellence.They are now looking for a driven Sales Executive Benelux, capable of elevating their commercial network and fostering long-term relationships.

Jobomschrijving

The Sales Executive Benelux will have the following responsibilities :

• Manage and develop relationships with the brand distribution network across the Benelux region.
• Conduct regular visits to points of sale to ensure operational excellence, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
• Build strong partnerships with retailers and act as the main point of contact for the brands.
• Maintain and actively manage CRM systems, ensuring accurate reporting and customer data management.
• Oversee visual merchandising standards to guarantee optimal brand image, visibility, and in-store presentation.
• Organize and deliver commercial training sessions for sales teams, focusing on product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer experience.
• Stay up to date with new product launches, brand developments, and watch market trends to effectively support and coach retail partners.

• First relevant experience in Retail or a Field Sales experience is expected
• Strong affinity for the watches industry
• Presentation and communication skills
• Client-driven, sense of service, attention to details
• Analytical skills
• Dutch native, Fluent in French and English

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager FMCG | Willing to relocate in Paris
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international player in the Non-Food FMCG sector, recognized for its portfolio of strong consumer brands and its commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainable growth. Present across multiple European markets, the company partners with major retailers and continuously invests in developing its brands, people, and commercial capabilities.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager will have the following responsibilities :

• Develop and manage strategic relationships with key retail accounts across Belgium and Luxembourg.
• Lead annual commercial negotiations, including pricing, promotions, trade terms, and joint business plans.
• Identify growth opportunities and implement account strategies to achieve sales and profitability targets.
• Drive category expansion, product launches, and promotional activations with retail partners.
• Monitor sales performance, market trends, and competitor activity to recommend corrective actions and growth initiatives.
• Prepare forecasts, business reviews, and account performance analyses for internal and external stakeholders.
• Ensure excellence in customer management while maximizing brand visibility and market share.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a Key Account Manager or similar commercial role within FMCG
• Proven experience negotiating with Belgian retail chains.
• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
• Fluent in French & Dutch. English is a strong asset.
• Willingness to relocate to Paris.

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer - Brussels - Venture Capital Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is an established investment management organisation based in Brussels, operating in an international and highly regulated environment. The offices are easily accessible and offer the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders on strategic compliance matters.

Jobomschrijving

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of the compliance and risk framework
• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of new regulatory requirements
• Oversee AML/CFT activities and participate in related control and reporting processes
• Support interactions with regulators, supervisory authorities and regulatory filings
• Assess and monitor outsourced service providers and ICT-related risks
• Provide compliance support across fund operations, including investment monitoring and conflict assessments
• Participate in regulatory analyses supporting new jurisdictions, fundraising activities and cross-border operations

• Master's degree in Law, Finance or a related field
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar Compliance position
• Experience within an AIFM, investment fund, private equity, venture capital, asset management or another regulated financial services organisation
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are valuable assets
• Strong knowledge of financial regulations, compliance controls and risk management practices
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret and apply evolving regulatory requirements
• Excellent communication skills and ability to interact with multiple internal and external stakeholders

Our client is a fast-growing organization active in the financial services sector. As part of its continued expansion, the company is investing heavily in digital transformation initiatives aimed at harmonizing processes, improving operational efficiency, and supporting the adoption of innovative technologies, including AI.

Jobomschrijving

As a Business Analyst, you will play a key role in the group's digital transformation journey. Working closely with business stakeholders and digital teams, you will analyze existing ways of working, identify improvement opportunities, and support the implementation of new tools and processes across multiple entities.This position is ideal for someone with a background in accounting or finance who has developed a strong interest in technology, process optimization, and digital transformation.Key responsibilities

• Analyze and document business processes across different entities.
• Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, and automation.
• Gather and challenge business requirements from key stakeholders.
• Act as the bridge between end-users, operational teams, and digital experts.
• Support the implementation and adoption of new digital solutions.
• Drive change management and promote best practices across the organization.
• Help users leverage new technologies and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.
• Provide training and guidance to internal teams on digital tools and new ways of working.
• Monitor user feedback and propose continuous improvements.

• 3 to 5 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Functional Analyst or Digital Transformation Consultant.
• Alternatively, experience in accounting combined with strong exposure to digital tools and process improvement.
• Knowledge of accounting and financial workflows.
• Familiarity with accounting software or digital finance solutions is a strong advantage.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Curious about technology, AI, and innovation.
• Hands-on mindset and willingness to work in a fast-growing environment.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Description
